name: Inaka Asobi ~Seken Shirazu no Shoujo o Iikurumete Doinran ni Naru made Okashitemita~
original_name: 田舎遊び～世間知らずの少女を言いくるめてド淫乱になるまで犯してみた～
source:
Years after their childhood, they met again.
Natsuki had grown into a lovely young lady.
Teruyoshi, who she had once called big brother, was a man.
Their attraction was undeniable. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE089216.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
童年分别多年后，两人终于再度相遇。
奈月已经长成一名亭亭玉立的少女。
而曾被她称作“哥哥”的照良，也已成为一个成年男人。
两人之间的吸引力，任谁都无法否认。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE089216.html]DLsite[/url]]
